options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: configured_name
options.description: Name of the URL category. This is only required for custom URL categories.

options.name: custom_category
options.description: Set to true for custom URL category. Up to 48 custom URL categories can be added per organization.

options.name: db_categorized_urls
options.description: URLs added to a custom URL category are also retained under the original parent URL category. i.e. the predefined category the URL previously belonged to. The URLs entered are covered by policies that reference the original parent URL category. If you add www.amazon.com, this URL is covered by policies that reference the custom URL category.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the URL category.

options.name: editable
options.description: Value is set to false for custom URL category when due to scope user does not have edit permission

options.name: id
options.description: URL category ID. See U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/url-categories#/urlCategories-get)

options.name: ip_ranges
options.description: Custom IP address ranges associated to a URL category. Up to 2000 custom IP address ranges and retaining parent custom IP address ranges can be added, per organization, across all categories. This field is available only if the option to configure custom IP ranges is enabled for your organization. To enable this option, contact Zscaler Support.

options.name: ip_ranges_retaining_parent_category
options.description: The retaining parent custom IP address ranges associated to a URL category. Up to 2000 custom IP ranges and retaining parent custom IP address ranges can be added, per organization, across all categories.

options.name: keywords
options.description: Custom keywords associated to a URL category. Up to 2048 custom keywords can be added per organization across all categories including bandwidth classes

options.name: keywords_retaining_parent_category
options.description: Retained custom keywords from the parent URL category that is associated to a URL category. Up to 2048 retained parent keywords can be added per organization across all categories including bandwidth classes.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: regex_patterns
options.description: Regular expression patterns used to match URLs when url_type is REGEX. Each entry is a regex pattern that URLs are evaluated against.

options.name: regex_patterns_retaining_parent_category
options.description: Retained regex patterns from the parent URL category when url_type is REGEX. Patterns from the parent category that remain associated with this custom category.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Scope of the custom categories.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: super_category
options.description: Super Category of the URL category. This field is required when creating custom URL categories.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the custom categories.

options.name: url_type
options.description: Type of URL matching for the category. EXACT matches exact URL strings; REGEX matches URLs using regular expression patterns.

options.name: urls
options.description: Retained custom keywords from the parent URL category that is associated to a URL category. Up to 2048 retained parent keywords can be added per organization across all categories including bandwidth classes.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
